clips.title: The story
paras: Unearthed from disturbed earth, the Neru Fragment carries part of the Goaz Stone's ancient Titan script. The relic was discovered at Whelgar's Excavation in the Wetlands, and its words tell of Azeroth's primeval history.

Prospector Whelgar led the dwarven expedition that discovered the Goaz Stone. The relic broke into four pieces: Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru. Raptors overran the dig, halting the work, and the Neru Fragment remained beneath loose soil among the aggressive beasts. Once recovered, it can join the other pieces and restore the tablet. Its surviving words speak of a divine plan and a doomed prophecy, giving dwarven scholars a record to decipher.
